name: Orpheon Eclipse Bridge
author: Orpheon
description: One ordered list of Eclipse music addons for MySpoti. Plays and downloads through your own addons with exact Spotify URI and ISRC resolution, per-addon settings, health tests and instant fallback.

actions.name: audio.source
actions.why: Play lossless audio through your enabled Eclipse addons

actions.name: download.source
actions.why: Download the same audio from your enabled Eclipse addons

actions.name: playback.events
actions.why: Read the upcoming queue and warm the next two songs so they start instantly

actions.name: network
actions.why: Reach the addon manifests, resolve routes and audio streams you configure

actions.name: webview.page
actions.why: Add, test, reorder, enable and configure addons on one page

actions.name: storage
actions.why: Keep the addon list, its per-addon settings and a short stream cache

actions.name: notify
actions.why: Report addon test results and configuration problems

welcome.message: Orpheon is a pure Eclipse addon bridge: no Eclipse Cloud account, login or subscription. Add the manifest URL of any Eclipse addon and Orpheon tries your enabled addons in order. Exact Spotify URI and ISRC requests go first; search matching is only the fallback.
steps: Open Orpheon's page and paste an addon manifest URL.
Press Test to confirm the addon answers, then add more addons if you want fallback.
Use the arrows to set the fallback order and enable or disable each addon.
Set each addon's own quality in its Settings panel.
Put Orpheon above Spotify in Playback and Downloads.

changelog: 1.0.3: Prefetch the next two queue tracks when a song starts, so their resolve and stream answers are already cached. Adds the playback.events permission. 1.0.2: Removed the automatic status probe so a slow addon cannot make MySpoti skip Orpheon. 1.0.1: Hardened stream expiry and rate-limit handling. 1.0.0: First pure bridge release.
